title: Firm Heterogeneity, Market Power and Macroeconomic Fragility
title_zh: 企业异质性、市场势力与宏观经济脆弱性
authors: Ferrari, Alessandro, Queirós, Francisco
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study how firm heterogeneity and market power affect macroeconomic fragility, defined as the probability of long slumps. We propose a theory where the positive interaction between firm entry, competition, and factor supply can give rise to multiple steady-states. We show that when firms are highly heterogeneous in terms of productivities, even small temporary shocks can trigger firm exit and make the economy spiral into a competition-driven poverty trap. We calibrate our model to incorporate the well-documented trends on rising firm heterogeneity in the US economy, and show that they significantly increase the likelihood and length of slow recoveries.
abstract_zh: 本文研究企业异质性与市场势力如何影响宏观经济脆弱性，即长期衰退的概率。我们提出一个理论，其中企业进入、竞争与要素供给之间的正向互动可能导致多重稳态。研究表明，当企业在生产率方面高度异质时，即使是微小的暂时性冲击也可能引发企业退出，并使经济陷入竞争驱动的贫困陷阱。我们通过校准模型纳入美国经济中企业异质性上升的已有趋势，并证明这些趋势显著增加了缓慢复苏的可能性与持续时间。

title: Digitalization and Credit Markets: Evidence from eInvoicing
title_zh: 数字化与信贷市场：来自电子发票的证据
authors: David Martinez-Miera, Alejandro Casado, Marco Giometti, Jose Gutierrez, Alexandra Matyunina, Tammaro Terracciano
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We document the effects of electronic invoicing (eInvoicing) on credit markets. By making invoices more standardized, verifiable, and harder to falsify, eInvoicing changes lenders’ information sets, facilitating invoice-based financing and credit risk assessment. We exploit a regional eInvoicing mandate and administrative credit data using a difference-in-differences design to provide three main insights. First, credit reallocates toward firms already relying on invoice-based credit (“invoice firms”) and away from non-invoice firms. Second, the cost of (non-)invoice credit falls (rises) for (non-)invoice firms, consistent with a supply-driven mechanism. Third, banks’ information production changes: eInvoicing widens (reduces) the dispersion of rates and banks’ risk assessments and improves (worsens) their predictive accuracy for (non-)invoice firms. Overall, eInvoicing reshapes credit market outcomes, with uneven effects across borrowers.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了电子发票对信贷市场的影响。通过使发票更加标准化、可验证且难以伪造，电子发票改变了贷款人的信息集，促进了基于发票的融资和信用风险评估。我们利用地区性电子发票强制政策及行政信贷数据，采用双重差分法得出三项主要发现。第一，信贷资源向已依赖发票信贷的企业（"发票企业"）重新配置，同时从非发票企业流出。第二，发票企业（非发票企业）的（非）发票信贷成本下降（上升），这与供给驱动机制一致。第三，银行的信息生产发生变化：电子发票扩大了（缩小了）利率和银行风险评估的离散程度，并改善（恶化）了对发票企业（非发票企业）的预测准确性。总体而言，电子发票重塑了信贷市场格局，但对不同借款人的影响存在差异。

title: Labor Market Consequences of Generative AI: Early Evidence from Norway
title_zh: 生成式人工智能对劳动力市场的影响：来自挪威的早期证据
authors: Dennis Facius & Roberto Iacono
official: 官方在线 2022-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Does Generative AI displace early-career workers? We provide population-wide evidence from Norwegian administrative registers, 2015 through March 2025, exploiting the November 2022 release of ChatGPT as an availability shock. Using the within-firm composition difference-in-differences employed in recent work, supplemented with a synthetic difference-in-differences at the occupation level and a firm-level shift-share design, we find no robust evidence of employment displacement among young workers in highly AI-exposed occupations, nor any robust response across other age cohorts or on incumbent labor-market outcomes. While estimated coefficients for young workers are negative, in line with the existing literature, they are small and statistically insignificant. A backdating exercise on the synthetic difference-in-differences yields larger absolute estimates than the actual treatment date across most age bands. This suggests the apparent post-2022 decline reflects, at least in part, pre-existing secular trends rather than a clean AI-period break.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能是否取代了早期职业工作者？我们利用挪威行政登记数据（2015年至2025年3月）提供全人口层面的证据，以2022年11月ChatGPT的发布作为可得性冲击。采用近期研究中使用的企业内构成双重差分法，辅以职业层面的合成双重差分法和企业层面的份额转移设计，我们未发现年轻工作者在高人工智能暴露职业中存在就业替代的稳健证据，也未发现其他年龄群体或现有劳动力市场结果存在稳健反应。尽管年轻工作者的估计系数为负，与现有文献一致，但系数较小且统计上不显著。对合成双重差分法进行回溯检验发现，在大多数年龄段中，实际处理日期之前的绝对估计值大于实际处理日期之后的估计值。这表明2022年后的表面下降至少部分反映了既有的长期趋势，而非人工智能时期的明确结构性断裂。

title: How Efficient was the Affordable Care Act at Reducing Uninsured Rates?
title_zh: 《平价医疗法案在降低未参保率方面的效率如何？》
authors: Anuj Gangopadhyaya, Robert Kaestner
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: One way to measure the efficiency of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) is the extent to which gains in publicly supported health insurance reduced uninsured rates. Using data from the 2008–2024 American Community Survey, we examine time trends in rates of uninsured, public insurance coverage, and employer-sponsored insurance (ESI) by groups defined by the ratio of income to the Federal Poverty Line (FPL). We obtain estimates of associations between changes in public coverage and changes in uninsured and ESI exploiting state-by-year variation in ACA implementation. Importantly, we estimate the total effect of the ACA—including both the Medicaid expansion and Marketplace coverage—on uninsured and ESI rates. For adults in households below 150% of the federal poverty level (FPL), increases in public insurance coverage were associated with one-for-one decrease in uninsured and no change in ESI. For adults with incomes between 151%–400% FPL, each percentage point increase in public coverage was associated with about a 0.6 percentage point decrease in uninsured and a 0.4 decrease, or crowd out, in ESI. Crowd-out was larger among groups with higher pre-ACA ESI rates such as parents and married adults. Using variation from the Medicaid expansion alone to evaluate the ACA’s effect on ESI leads to overstating crowd-out among low-income adults (below 150% FPL) and understating crowd-out among higher-income adults (above 250% FPL). Our findings suggest that policies intended to subsidize health insurance of higher income groups, for example, the enhanced premium subsidies, are far less efficient than policies intended to further expand public insurance to low-income groups, for example, in non-expansion states.
abstract_zh: 衡量《平价医疗法案》（ACA）效率的一个方法是，公共资助医疗保险的覆盖增长在多大程度上降低了未参保率。利用2008-2024年美国社区调查数据，我们按收入与联邦贫困线（FPL）之比划分群体，考察了未参保率、公共保险覆盖率以及雇主提供保险（ESI）的时间趋势。我们利用各州在ACA实施中的年度差异，估算了公共保险覆盖率变化与未参保率及ESI变化之间的关联。重要的是，我们评估了ACA的总体效应——包括医疗补助扩展和市场保险覆盖——对未参保率和ESI的影响。对于家庭收入低于联邦贫困线150%的成年人，公共保险覆盖率的增加与未参保率的一对一下降相关，而ESI无变化。对于收入在联邦贫困线151%-400%之间的成年人，公共保险覆盖率每增加一个百分点，未参保率下降约0.6个百分点，ESI下降0.4个百分点（即挤出效应）。在ACA实施前ESI率较高的群体（如父母和已婚成年人）中，挤出效应更大。仅利用医疗补助扩展的变异来评估ACA对ESI的影响，会导致低估低收入成年人（低于150% FPL）的挤出效应，而高估高收入成年人（高于250% FPL）的挤出效应。我们的研究结果表明，旨在补贴高收入群体医疗保险的政策（例如增强型保费补贴）远不如旨在进一步向低收入群体扩展公共保险的政策（例如在非扩展州）有效。

title: Gender Gaps in the Urban Wage Premium
title_zh: DP19592 城市工资溢价中的性别差距
authors: Kenza Elass, Cecilia García-Peñalosa, Christian Schluter
official: 官方在线 2024-10-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine the economic geography of gender wage gaps to understand the role that location plays in gender earning differences. Using panelised administrative data for the universe of French workers, our findings indicate that women benefit relatively more from density than men, with an urban wage premium (return to urban density) 48% higher than for men. We identify a number of factors that explain this gap, with a large share being explained by the structure of the local labour market, notably, the extent of occupational segregation. Another important factor is commuting patterns, while childcare availability plays only a moderate role.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了性别工资差距的经济地理学，以理解地理位置在性别收入差异中的作用。利用法国全体劳动者的面板化行政数据，研究结果表明，女性从城市密度中获得的相对收益高于男性，其城市工资溢价（城市密度的回报率）比男性高出48%。我们识别出若干解释这一差距的因素，其中很大一部分归因于当地劳动力市场的结构，尤其是职业隔离的程度。另一个重要因素是通勤模式，而儿童保育的可获得性仅起到中等程度的作用。

title: Were American Parents Really Selfish? Child Labour in the 19th Century
title_zh: 19世纪的美国父母真的自私吗？童工问题研究

official: 官方在线 2006-05-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using the US Commissioner of Labor Survey of 1890, we examine household decisions and parental altruism vis-a-vis their children. Contrary to Parsons and Goldin (1989), we find that parental location choices were dictated by constraints rather than the desire to exploit child labour opportunities. We also find signfiicant income effects on child labour supply, indicating that rising affluence played an important part in the secular decline of child labour. We also find that the effects of childrens' income on their own consumption are weak, once child labour is controlled for.
abstract_zh: 利用1890年美国劳工专员调查数据，本文考察了家庭决策及父母对子女的利他主义倾向。与Parsons和Goldin（1989）的结论相反，我们发现父母区位选择受制于约束条件，而非出于利用童工机会的动机。同时，收入对童工供给存在显著影响，表明收入水平提升在童工现象的长期衰退中发挥了重要作用。此外，在控制童工变量后，子女收入对其自身消费的影响较为微弱。

title: Political Foundations of the Resource Curse
title_zh: 资源诅咒的政治基础
authors: Thierry Verdier, James A. Robinson, Ragnar Torvik
official: 官方在线 2002-06-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In this Paper we argue that the political incentives that resource endowments generate are the key to understanding whether or not they are a curse. We show: (1) politicians tend to over-extract natural resources relative to the efficient extraction path because they discount the future too much; (2) resource booms improve the efficiency of the extraction path; (3) resource booms, however, by raising the value of being in power and by providing politicians with more resources which they can use to influence the outcome of elections, increase resource misallocation in the rest of the economy and (4) the overall impact of resource booms on the economy depends critically on institutions, since these determine the extent to which political incentives map into policy outcomes. Countries with good institutions tend to benefit from resource booms since these institutions mitigate the perverse political incentives that such booms create. Countries with bad institutions suffer a resource curse.
abstract_zh: 本文认为，资源禀赋所产生的政治激励是理解其是否成为“诅咒”的关键。我们证明：（1）政治家倾向于过度开采自然资源，偏离有效开采路径，因为他们对未来过度折现；（2）资源繁荣会改善开采路径的效率；（3）然而，资源繁荣通过提升执政价值，并为政治家提供更多可用于影响选举结果的资源，加剧了经济其他领域的资源错配；（4）资源繁荣对经济的总体影响关键取决于制度，因为制度决定了政治激励在多大程度上转化为政策结果。制度良好的国家往往能从资源繁荣中受益，因为这些制度缓解了繁荣所引发的扭曲性政治激励；而制度不良的国家则会遭受资源诅咒。
